gloss: to look good (on camera); to be photogenic

definitions.gloss: to look good (on camera); to be photogenic
definitions.explanation: Describes something that looks attractive in photos or videos. A modern colloquial term derived from {映|は}える (はえる, to shine/stand out).

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧、⟦すごく→すごく：18751_sugoku⟧{映|ば}える⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: This dish looks really good in photos.

examples.japanese: {映|ば}える⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}りたい→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
examples.english: I want to take a photogenic picture.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{映|ば}え⟦スポット→スポット：11578_supotto⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: This cafe is famous as a photogenic spot.
examples.notes: {映|ば}え⟦スポット→スポット：11578_supotto⟧ = Instagrammable spot

examples.japanese: ⟦インスタ→インスタ：28008_insuta⟧⟦{映|ば}え→映え：25470_bae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{狙|ねら}って→狙う：00313_nerau⟧⟦{盛|も}り{付|つ}け→盛り付け：05754_moritsuke⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{工夫|くふう}→工夫：00250_kufuu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I arranged the presentation carefully aiming for an Instagram-worthy look.

examples.japanese: ⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{鮮|あざ}やか→鮮やか：05702_azayaka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{映|ば}える⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}りたがる→撮る：00760_toru⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The colors are so vivid and photogenic that everyone wants to take pictures there.

notes:
{映|ば}える (ばえる) is a modern colloquial term that became popular with social media culture, particularly Instagram. It's derived from the traditional verb ⟦{映|は}える→映える：02393_haeru⟧ (はえる, to shine/stand out).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {映|ば}える⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧ (ばえるしゃしん): photogenic photo
- ⟦{映|ば}え→映え：25470_bae⟧⟦スポット→スポット：11578_supotto⟧ (ばえ⟦スポット→スポット：11578_supotto⟧): Instagrammable spot
- ⟦インスタ→インスタ：28008_insuta⟧⟦{映|ば}え→映え：25470_bae⟧ (いんすたばえ): Instagram-worthy

COMMON PATTERNS:
- The thing that photographs well is the subject, marked with ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ or ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧; there is no object.
- The masu-stem noun ⟦{映|ば}え→映え：25470_bae⟧ is used at least as often as the verb, almost always as the second half of a compound: ⟦インスタ→インスタ：28008_insuta⟧⟦{映|ば}え→映え：25470_bae⟧, ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦{映|ば}え→映え：25470_bae⟧. That compound position is where the voiced ば- reading comes from — it is rendaku on ⟦{映|は}える→映える：02393_haeru⟧ — and the standalone verb {映|ば}える is a back-formation from it.
- It says nothing about how something looks in person, only how it comes out in a photo or video.

USAGE:
This reading ばえる is informal and belongs to social-media speech; it would be out of place in writing. The standard reading ⟦{映|は}える→映える：02393_haeru⟧ (はえる) means "to shine" or "to stand out attractively" in a more general sense and is neutral in register.
